name: phone-tools-confirmation
purpose: Verify that a confirmed phone-tool write never blocks concurrent reads, that a second write queues behind the current card, and that a result whose socket send failed is held and flushed on reconnect (never re-executed).
prerequisites: Pair the app to the mock hub with phone tools enabled.
Enable the Calendar and Device info data sources under Settings > Connectors > This phone.
Keep the app in the foreground for the foreground scenes; switch to background for the notification scenes.

scenes.expect: One confirmation card visible with Allow and Deny; Allow is greyed on the lock screen on API 31+. Button labels stay on a single line at maximum font size.
Only the first card is on screen; the second is queued. Resolving the first promotes the second; a stale tap on the first token does not answer the second.
Reads complete and render their results in the chat while the confirmation card is still on screen; the call-id of each execute is logged once per call.
A high-priority notification on channel phone_tools_confirmation with Allow and Deny actions and a delete intent. No setTimeoutAfter: the card waits until the user answers or the runtime closes.
After the connection recovers the held result is re-sent by call_id; the tool is not re-executed and the confirmation card does not reappear.
The chat shows the uncertain wording (the write may have landed; do not retry automatically). The confirmation card is gone; a repeated call_id replays the cached uncertain result.

manualChecks: Lock the device: Allow must require an unlock on API 31+; Deny works from the lock screen.
Swipe the notification away: only that card ends as Dismissed, the next queued one is unaffected.
Rotate the device while a card is on screen: the same card stays, the queue does not advance.
Kill the process while a write waits: after restart nothing is replayed automatically; a fresh call_id is required to retry.
Background reachability and timing on Chinese ROMs: not measured; do not quote numbers.
